("Owasco"), a New York corporation, with offices at One East Fourth Street, Cincinnati, Ohio 45202, and THE NEW YORK AND HARLEM RAILROAD COMPANY ("NYHRC"), a New York corporation with offices at One East Fourth Street, Cincinnati, Ohio 45202 (collectively, “Transferor"), and NIPM 342 Madison LLC, a New York limited liability company with an office at 142 West 57th Street, 15th Floor, New York, New York 10019 ("Transferee").
